source: idea cards by subagents from each iteration's code diff and the agent's notes; families, order and similarity by one subagent over all cards

clusters.label: RL on the raw reward
clusters.description: GRPO on the proxy reward minus a monitor penalty on all prompts; hack bonus is optimized directly.
clusters.plain: Plain RL on the env's reward on every prompt (bonus included), minus the monitor's penalty: the starting point.

clusters.label: RL, raw reward capped by a judge
clusters.description: Trusted reward on trusted prompts; untrusted prompts still use the proxy reward but capped/bounded by a trusted-derived estimate (min(proxy, learned judge) or bounded proxy weight).
clusters.plain: Trusted prompts pay their reward; other prompts pay the lower of their reward and a judge trained only on trusted answers, so a bonus the judge doesn't believe is cut off.

clusters.label: RL + extra cheat detectors
clusters.description: Trusted-reward GRPO with penalty-only untrusted groups, where hack evidence beyond the monitor (activation probe, sacrificial hacker-adapter likelihood ratio, reward above trusted ceiling) is penalized.
clusters.plain: RL on trusted prompts' reward, plus detectors beyond the monitor (a probe on activations, a deliberately-cheating twin model, or reward above anything trusted prompts pay) whose flags cost reward.

clusters.label: RL on trusted, penalize flags
clusters.description: GRPO with task reward only on trusted prompts; untrusted prompts get zero task reward and only the monitor penalty (one-sided push-down), often with trusted-val checkpointing and temperature folding.
clusters.plain: RL on trusted prompts' reward; the other prompts earn nothing and only lose reward when the monitor flags an answer.

clusters.label: RL on trusted prompts only
clusters.description: GRPO on trusted prompts only (untrusted prompts never drawn), reward = trusted reward minus monitor penalty, sometimes length shaping.
clusters.plain: RL on trusted prompts' reward alone; the other prompts are never used.

clusters.label: Copy best answer + RL
clusters.description: Trusted-prompt policy gradient combined with best-of-n imitation: simultaneous GRPO+elite SFT, SFT warmup then PG anchored to the distilled policy, or PG projected against imitation gradients.
clusters.plain: Train on each trusted prompt's best clean sample, combined with RL on trusted prompts' reward.

clusters.label: Copy best + unlearn flagged
clusters.description: Best-of-n SFT on trusted prompts plus an explicit contrastive loss pushing down monitor-flagged (and sometimes longer) samples via DPO or unlikelihood, sometimes using untrusted prompts for monitor labels only.
clusters.plain: Train on each trusted prompt's best clean sample, and push down answers the monitor flags (on any prompt).

clusters.label: Copy best trusted answer
clusters.description: No policy gradient: on trusted prompts, imitate each group's best monitor-clean sample (shortest tie-break, elite threshold, replay); hacking handled by filtering teachers and never reading untrusted reward.
clusters.plain: Sample several answers per trusted prompt and train on the best one the monitor didn't flag (shortest on ties); nothing else.

clusters.label: Copy best + self-labels
clusters.description: Trusted best-of-n SFT plus imitation of self-generated pseudo-labels on untrusted prompts (consensus/confidence/learned-prior filtered) whose proxy reward is never read.
clusters.plain: Train on each trusted prompt's best clean sample, plus the model's own majority answers on the other prompts (their reward is never read).
